segments.thag16.5:1.1: [saṃ. ni.4.95]“Rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto;
segments.thag16.5:4.1: “Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā rūpasambhavā; Abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittamassūpahaññati; Evamācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbāna [nibbānaṃ (sī.)] vuccati. “Saddaṃ sutvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto; Sārattacitto vedeti, tañca ajjhossa tiṭṭhati.
segments.thag16.5:5.1: “Gandhaṃ ghatvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto;
segments.thag16.5:8.1: “Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā gandhasambhavā; Abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittamassūpahaññati; Evamācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbāna vuccati. “Rasaṃ bhotvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto; Sārattacitto vedeti, tañca ajjhossa tiṭṭhati.
segments.thag16.5:9.1: “Phassaṃ phussa sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto;
segments.thag16.5:12.1: “Tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā phassasambhavā; Abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittamassūpahaññati; Evamācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbāna vuccati. “Dhammaṃ ñatvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto; Sārattacitto vedeti, tañca ajjhossa tiṭṭhati.
segments.thag16.5:13.1: “Na so rajjati rūpesu, rūpaṃ disvā patissato;
segments.thag16.5:16.1: “Yathāssa passato rūpaṃ, sevato cāpi vedanaṃ; Khīyati nopacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato; Evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbāna vuccati. “Na so rajjati saddesu, saddaṃ sutvā patissato; Virattacitto vedeti, tañca nājjhossa tiṭṭhati. “Yathāssa suṇato saddaṃ, sevato cāpi vedanaṃ;
segments.thag16.5:16.3: Khīyati nopacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato;
segments.thag16.5:16.5: Evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbāna vuccati.
segments.thag16.5:17.1: “Na so rajjati gandhesu, gandhaṃ ghatvā patissato;
segments.thag16.5:20.1: “Yathāssa ghāyato gandhaṃ, sevato cāpi vedanaṃ; Khīyati nopacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato; Evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbāna vuccati. “Na so rajjati rasesu, rasaṃ bhotvā patissato; Virattacitto vedeti, tañca nājjhossa tiṭṭhati. “Yathāssa sāyarato rasaṃ, sevato cāpi vedanaṃ;
segments.thag16.5:20.3: Khīyati nopacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato;
segments.thag16.5:20.5: Evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbāna vuccati.
segments.thag16.5:21.1: “Na so rajjati phassesu, phassaṃ phussa patissato;
segments.thag16.5:24.1: “Yathāssa phusato phassaṃ, sevato cāpi vedanaṃ; Khīyati nopacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato; Evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbāna vuccati. “Na so rajjati dhammesu, dhammaṃ ñatvā patissato; Virattacitto vedeti, tañca nājjhossa tiṭṭhati. “Yathāssa vijānato dhammaṃ, sevato cāpi vedanaṃ;
segments.thag16.5:24.3: Khīyati nopacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato;
segments.thag16.5:24.5: Evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbāna vuccati”.

lines: Yathāssa passato rūpanti assa yogino yathā tattha abhijjhādayo nappavattanti, evaṃ aniccādito rūpaṃ passantassa.
Sevato cāpi vedananti taṃ ārabbha uppannaṃ vedanaṃ taṃsampayuttadhamme ca gocarasevanāya sevato cāpi.
Evaṃ so caratī satoti evaṃ kilesāpanayanapaṭipattiyā sato sampajāno hutvā carati, viharati.
Evaṃ apacinato dukkhanti vuttanayena apacayagāminiyā maggapaññāya sakalaṃ vaṭṭadukkhaṃ apacinantassa.
Santike nibbāna vuccatīti saupādisesaanupādisesanibbānadhātusamīpe evāti vuccati asaṅkhatāya dhātuyā sacchikatattā.
Na so rajjati saddesūtiādīsupi imināva nayena attho veditabbo.
